RotationStep.Name: Rotation Step
RotationStep.Hint: Degrees by which selected Tokens or Tiles are rotated per command. Default: 15°.

CounterClockwise.Name: Rotate Selected Objects Counter-Clockwise
CounterClockwise.Hint: Rotate selected objects on the active Token or Tile layer counter-clockwise by the configured step.

Clockwise.Name: Rotate Selected Objects Clockwise
Clockwise.Hint: Rotate selected objects on the active Token or Tile layer clockwise by the configured step.

Reset.Name: Reset Selected Object Rotation
Reset.Hint: Reset selected objects on the active Token or Tile layer to 0°.

NoSelection.Token: Select at least one Token first.
NoSelection.Tile: Select at least one Tile first.

NoPermission.Token: You do not have permission to rotate the selected Token(s).
NoPermission.Tile: You do not have permission to rotate the selected Tile(s).

Notifications.Skipped: {count} selected object(s) were skipped because you cannot modify them.
Notifications.UnsupportedLayer: Activate the Token or Tile layer before using this rotation keybinding.
Notifications.Error: Rotation failed. See the browser console for details.
